title: Unsupervised Concept Vector Extraction for Bias Control in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring disparity scores in output probabilities for contrasting gender concepts (female vs. male) and evaluating on downstream tasks including pronoun resolution (Winogenerated) and frequency of occupational titles predicted conditionally on feminine versus masculine names.

Measuring disparity scores in output probabilities of race-associated tokens (e.g., White, Black) when prompting models with text written in different dialects, specifically White Mainstream English (WME) versus African American Language (AAL).
